title: ProgressionShop
description: NPC GUI shops with buy/sell logic—RPG-style merchants for real server economies.
body:
# ProgressionShop 

Chest shops feel clunky. ProgressionShop feels like an MMO: clean NPC GUI merchants, structured pages, and fast buy/sell flow that players instantly understand. It’s ideal for real economies, trader towns, and reward systems where custom items matter.

# Highlights:

NPC-driven GUI shops (buy/sell)

Clean, structured configuration for scalable shop setups

Built for custom item integration and progression economies

Perfect for: economy hubs, merchant towns, quest rewards.

# Why you’ll love it

Looks and feels like an MMO merchant system

Players understand it instantly: click, buy, sell, done

Perfect for custom items and progression economies

# Features

NPC-based GUI shops

Buy/sell logic with clean configuration

Structured pages/categories for large shop systems

Great with custom items/spec identity

# Setup

Install the plugin

Create shop configs (pages/categories)

Link shops to NPCs

Test pricing and item matching

# Compatibility

Platform: Paper / Spigot (Paper recommended)

Best with: NPC + Economy + custom items
